name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: Animated scroll progress bar for your pages.

examples.name: scroll-progress-demo
examples.title: Page
examples.description: Fixed to the top of the viewport; here offset with `className="top-14"` to sit under the navbar.

examples.name: scroll-progress-container
examples.title: Scroll container
examples.description: Track a scrollable element with `container` and make the bar `sticky`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the bar — position (`top-*`), thickness (`h-*`) or colours (`from-*`, `via-*`, `to-*`). Other div props are passed through.

props.name: container
props.description: Ref to a scrollable element to track instead of the page. Not in Magic UI.
